Principal Arrested for Allegedly Killing Clerk Over PF Dispute

A principal in Etah has been accused of murdering a clerk from his own school. The alleged motive for the killing is a dispute over Provident Fund (PF) matters. The principal was reportedly apprehended while attempting to dispose of the body in his car.
